title: Matching-map epimorphisms imply local lifting of all lower simplex data
statement: Let X be a scheme and U an augmented simplicial object in the slice over a pro-etale site object W. Suppose U_0 to W is epic on represented sheaves; the degree-one fan matching object exists in the slice and U_1 to it is epic on represented sheaves; and in each higher degree the proper-face multicospan matching object [lem-weil-pbc-simplicial-matching-object] exists with an epic represented matching map. Then for any test object T, map w:T to W, degree n, and compatible maps from T to U_Delta for every Delta of dimension less than n and operator Delta to [n], augmented by w, there is a covering sieve S of T such that every f:V to T in S has a lift t:V to U_n. This lift is over f w and induces all prescribed maps after restriction along every lower-simplex operator.

proof.text: Pass the data to the slice over W. In degree zero there are no lower simplices and the matching map is U_0 to W. In degree one the two vertex maps give a map into the limiting fan. In degree n+2 the prescribed codimension-one faces satisfy the face-pair equations by the lower-simplex compatibility and the simplex face-face identity; their tuple gives a map into the supplied limiting multicospan. This uses the universal property of the limits in the hypotheses, not a choice of a new matching object.

Apply representable_epi_local_lifting to the supplied matching epimorphism and the section into the limiting matching object. Its covering image sieve and local lifts give the codimension-one faces by the projection equations. Composing the lifted equation with the augmentation gives t over f w.

A lower-dimensional simplex operator into [n] is not surjective on vertices, by the finite cardinality inequality. Factor it through a face with SimplexCategory.eq_comp_δ_of_not_surjective. Expand the contravariant functor on this factorization, apply the face equality and the given compatibility equation. This is the private fully proved lower_simplex_eq_of_faces. Degree zero has no lower simplex operators; the empty case follows from its impossible dimension inequality.

from.place: Bounded-below hypercover descent, Matching-map epimorphisms imply local lifting of all lower simplex data

lean.statement:
theorem hypercover_matching_local_lifting
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt) (U : SimplicialObject (Over W))
    (hzero : Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map (U _⦋0⦌).hom))
    (hone : ∃ c : Fan (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ U _⦋0⦌), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
      ∃ μ : U _⦋1⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
        (∀ i : Fin 2, μ ≫ c.proj i = U.δ i) ∧
        Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map μ.left))
    (hhigher : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ c : Cone (SimplicialObject.matchingBoundaryIndex U n).multicospan,
        Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ ∃ μ : U _⦋n + 2⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
          (∀ i : Fin (n + 3), μ ≫ c.π.app (WalkingMulticospan.left i) = U.δ i) ∧
          Epi ((topology X).yoneda.map μ.left)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (T : X.ProEt) (w : T ⟶ W)
      (p : ∀ (Δ : SimplexCategory), Δ.len < n →
        (Δ ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk n) → (T ⟶ (U ⋙ Over.forget W).obj (op Δ))),
      (∀ (Δ : SimplexCategory) (h : Δ.len < n) (θ : Δ ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk n),
        p Δ h θ ≫ (hypercoverUnderlyingAugmentation X W U).app (op Δ) = w) →
      (∀ (Δ Δ' : SimplexCategory) (h : Δ.len < n) (h' : Δ'.len < n)
        (α : Δ' ⟶ Δ) (θ : Δ ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk n),
        p Δ h θ ≫ (U ⋙ Over.forget W).map α.op = p Δ' h' (α ≫ θ)) →
      ∃ S : Sieve T, S ∈ topology X T ∧
        ∀ (V : X.ProEt) (f : V ⟶ T), S f →
          ∃ t : V ⟶ (U ⋙ Over.forget W) _⦋n⦌,
            t ≫ (hypercoverUnderlyingAugmentation X W U).app
              (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) = f ≫ w ∧
            ∀ (Δ : SimplexCategory) (h : Δ.len < n) (θ : Δ ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk n),
              t ≫ (U ⋙ Over.forget W).map θ.op = f ≫ p Δ h θ
